data.name: Aabeer
data.gender_notes: Aabeer is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'abar', meaning 'a star'. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) saw stars in the sky and named his daughter Ibrahim's daughter Isra (Asia) as a sign of her beauty and radiance. Aabeer is a name filled with hope, light, and brilliance. The name Aabeer carries the meaning “A star or shining one” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aabeer usually hope their child will grow to embody a star or shining one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of divine guidance and illumination
data.etymology: Aabeer belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “A star or shining one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aabeer total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: آبير

in_pashto.name: آبیړ
